REPLACE:bno_lanun_admiralty_bureaucracy = {
	implementation_price = price:implement_bureaucracy_price
	maintenance_price = price:maintain_bureaucracy_price
	removal_price = price:remove_bureaucracy_price
	maintenance_price_modifier = {
		value = country_economical_base
		multiply = 0.003
	}

	potential = {
		has_or_had_tag = BNO
		has_game_rule = nd_bureaucracies_enabled
	}

	allow = {}

	estates_that_like = {
		crown_estate
		nobles_estate
	}
	estates_that_dislike = {
		burghers_estate
	}

	# Licensing the Iranun and Balanini squadrons under sultanic charter
	# means the lanun captains sail with the throne's flag stamped on
	# their prahus, deliver a published share of every prize to the
	# sultan's customs at Brunei or Tempasuk, and take their disputes
	# before the sultan's court rather than fighting them out at sea:
	# piracy becomes an arm of the state.
	neutral_modifier = {
		amount_looted_modifier = 0.20
	}

	# Functioning (the licensed cruises sailing on the April monsoon,
	# the prizes auctioned at Jolo and Tempasuk, the throne's tenth
	# reliably collected, the captured Spanish and Dutch crews
	# ransomed back through the Sulu intermediaries), the lanun
	# admiralty gives the realm a fearsome cheap navy: foreign
	# squadrons learn to avoid the Sulu Sea between Mindoro and the
	# Sulu archipelago, and Spanish, Dutch, and Bugis trade routes
	# pay the throne in tribute or in plunder.
	positive_modifier = {
		scale = { value = scope:maintenance }
		navy_initiative = 0.85
		ship_capture_chance = 0.05
		monthly_navy_tradition = 0.1
	}

	# When the licensing system collapses (the throne's tenth
	# uncollected, the lanun captains raiding the realm's own coasts
	# for slaves rather than the rivals', the Spanish and Dutch
	# steam-gunboats finally arriving in numbers), the prahu fleets
	# turn predator on Bornean ports themselves, every legitimate
	# merchant abandons the northern coast for Manila or Singapore,
	# and the institution that protected the realm from foreign
	# squadrons becomes the casus belli for their long-postponed
	# vengeance.
	negative_modifier = {
		scale = {
			value = 1
			subtract = scope:maintenance

REPLACE:can_seigneurial_tenure_bureaucracy = {
	implementation_price = price:implement_bureaucracy_price
	maintenance_price = price:maintain_bureaucracy_price
	removal_price = price:remove_bureaucracy_price
	maintenance_price_modifier = {
		value = country_economical_base
		multiply = 0.003
	}

	potential = {
		has_or_had_tag = CAN
		has_game_rule = nd_bureaucracies_enabled
	}

	allow = {
		OR = {
			owns = location:stadacona
			owns = location:hochelaga
		}
	}

	estates_that_like = {
		nobles_estate
		clergy_estate
	}
	estates_that_dislike = {
		peasants_estate
	}

	# The cens et rentes is collected and the banalite enforced; the
	# seigneur owes faith and homage at the Chateau and the habitant
	# owes the mill, the oven, and the press. The rang strips along
	# the St. Lawrence are the structure of rural Lower Canada whether
	# any seigneur is energetic or not.
	neutral_modifier = {
		nobles_estate_target_satisfaction = small_permanent_target_satisfaction
	}

	# The seigneurs energetic (mills running, granges full, militia
	# captains called from the rang in time of war, droits seigneuriaux
	# faithfully rendered), the system delivers what concessionary
	# Bourbon land tenure was meant to deliver: settled habitant
	# parishes, recruitable manpower, and a loyal noble class with a
	# stake in the colony.
	positive_modifier = {
		scale = { value = scope:maintenance }
		global_levy_size_modifier = 0.05
		global_monthly_food_modifier = 0.085
		tax_income_efficiency = 0.05
	}

	# The droits ground down to the form (the banalite mill broken
	# and unrepaired, the lods et ventes resented at every habitant
	# property transfer, Papineau's Patriotes pamphleteering against
	# "feudal incumbrances"), the rang fills with refusals and the
	# habitant owes a duty he no longer concedes is his.
	negative_modifier = {
		scale = {
			value = 1
			subtract = scope:maintenance
		}
		peasants_estate_target_satisfaction = small_permanent_target_satisfaction_penalty
		global_max_rural_control = -0.05
	}
}

		# not never.
		global_prosperity_decay = -0.0085

	# revenue extraction from the realm.
	neutral_modifier = {
		estate_enrichment = 0.05
	}

	# Working as designed: every vassal chief brings ivory, gold, hoes, and
	# cloth to renew submission; absence is rebellion. The king redistributes
	# part of the gifts to bind chiefs back into the hierarchy. Joao dos Santos
	# in 1609 described curva as the central event of the imperial calendar.

		monthly_devotion = 0.04
		monthly_republican_tradition = 0.04
		nobles_estate_target_satisfaction = small_permanent_target_satisfaction
	}

	# Decaying: chiefs no longer attend; the redistribution lapses but the
	# extractive demand on cultivators below them does not. The throne's
	# annual binding ritual hollows into rural exploitation without political
	# cohesion.
	negative_modifier = {
		scale = {
			value = 1
			subtract = scope:maintenance
		}
		peasants_estate_target_satisfaction = small_permanent_target_satisfaction_penalty
		monthly_inflation = 0.002
		annexation_speed_modifier = -0.15
	}

	}
	estates_that_dislike = {
		nobles_estate

	# Burgundian gros holds its weight in markets from Hamburg to Genoa; the
	# urban patriciate (which staffs the chamber) entrenches itself as

		}

	}

	removal_price = price:remove_bureaucracy_price
	maintenance_price_modifier = {
		value = country_economical_base
		multiply = 0.003
	}

	potential = {
		has_or_had_tag = IRO
		has_game_rule = nd_bureaucracies_enabled
	}

	allow = {}

	estates_that_like = {
		tribes_estate
		nobles_estate
	}
	estates_that_dislike = {
		peasants_estate
	}

	# Clan mothers hold the right to raise mourning wars; war chiefs
	# accept the obligation; longhouses keep places open for the
	# adopted-in dead. The institution is permanent: the Confederacy
	# replenishes itself by absorbing the conquered.
	neutral_modifier = {
		global_pop_assimilation_speed_modifier = 0.05
	}

	# Mourning wars raised promptly when the matrons demand them, war
	# chiefs gathering volunteers from every longhouse, captives marched
	# back from the Ohio and the Susquehanna and ritually adopted into
	# the dead's places: the Confederacy weathers the smallpox years,
	# fields warriors at numbers its birth-population could not sustain,
	# and turns demographic crisis into geopolitical reach.
	positive_modifier = {
		scale = { value = scope:maintenance }
		global_manpower_modifier = 0.15
		global_population_growth = 0.00218
		casus_belli_creation_speed_modifier = -0.15
	}

	# Mourning wars raised faster than warriors return, captive-adoption
	# mishandled and refugees half-integrated, the western raids
	# turning into wars of attrition that the Confederacy cannot win
	# at the demographic ledger: the longhouse villages are emptied,
	# the corn fields untended, and the western nations begin to
	# coalesce against the Five Nations rather than feed them.
	negative_modifier = {
		scale = {
			value = 1
			subtract = scope:maintenance
		}
		peasants_estate_satisfaction_decay = 0.01
		global_max_rural_control = -0.05
	}
}

REPLACE:liv_hanseatic_stadtrat_bureaucracy = {
	implementation_price = price:implement_bureaucracy_price
	maintenance_price = price:maintain_bureaucracy_price
	removal_price = price:remove_bureaucracy_price

	potential = {
		has_or_had_tag = LIV
		has_game_rule = nd_bureaucracies_enabled
	}

	# The Stadtrat institution requires possession of a Hanseatic founding city,
	# Riga (chartered 1201 under Lübeck Law), Reval/Tallinn (1248), or
	# Dorpat, where the elected Rat, Bürgermeister, and Brotherhood of
	# Blackheads actually sit.
	allow = {
		OR = {
			owns = location:riga
			owns = location:tallinn
			owns = location:tartu
		}
	}

	estates_that_like = {
		burghers_estate
	}
	estates_that_dislike = {
		nobles_estate
	}

	# A working Hanseatic Rat means the wealthiest Low German merchant
	# lineages of Riga, Reval, and Dorpat hold elected office for life,
	# accumulate landed estates and shipping interests through the Brotherhood
	# of Blackheads, and present the realm a coherent commercial elite that
	# negotiates collectively with the Hochmeister, Lübeck, and Novgorod.
	neutral_modifier = {
		estate_enrichment = 0.05
	}

	# Working as designed: the Rat of each city, four Bürgermeister presiding
	# in rotation, sends magistrates to the Hansetag at Lübeck; the Riga
	# Peterhof manages the Novgorod fur and wax trade; the Brotherhood of
	# Blackheads (consecrated 1407 in Reval, 1416 in Riga) provides the
	# city militia and a permanent merchant-society that absorbs incoming
	# Low German immigrants into the urban patriciate. Riga's harbor revenue
	# alone rivals the Order's military budget.
	positive_modifier = {
		scale = { value = scope:maintenance }
		trade_sea_efficiency = 0.10
		global_non_rural_monthly_prosperity = 0.0017
		burghers_estate_target_satisfaction = small_permanent_target_satisfaction
	}

	# Decaying: the Hanseatic Kontor system fractures as Lübeck's primacy
	# falters and Dutch and English shippers route around it; Riga's Rat
	# turns into a closed oligarchy of three or four lineages; the Blackheads
	# devolve into a drinking society; and the rural population finds itself
	# squeezed between predatory urban factors and an unchecked grain market
	# that prices peasants out of their own crops.
	negative_modifier = {
		scale = {
			value = 1
			subtract = scope:maintenance

		clergy_estate
		peasants_estate
	}
	estates_that_dislike = {
		nobles_estate

	# shrine's mere presence enlarges its temple-cities.
	neutral_modifier = {
		global_clergy_city_desired_pop_scaled = 0.076
	}

	# Working: hundi offerings circulate as low-interest temple credit;
	# pilgrim crowds redistribute prosperity across the Coromandel
	# hinterland; peasant cultivators benefit from temple grain reserves.
	positive_modifier = {
		scale = { value = scope:maintenance }
		global_monthly_prosperity = 0.0017
		peasants_estate_target_satisfaction = small_permanent_target_satisfaction
		trade_income = 0.10
	}

	# Decaying: temple wealth becomes a target. Without active royal
	# protection, Nayaka warlords skim hundi receipts, the great
	# endowment is dissipated into private retinues, and pilgrim routes
	# become unsafe.
	negative_modifier = {
		scale = {
			value = 1
			subtract = scope:maintenance
		}
		amount_looted_modifier = 0.10
		clergy_estate_satisfaction_decay = 0.020
	}

	# their Holzgrafen and stabilises the rural fabric of the territory.
	neutral_modifier = {
		peasants_estate_can_participate_in_parliament = yes
	}

	# Funded (meaning the Markdinge convene on schedule, the Holzgrafen
	# are paid, and grazing-right disputes are settled by communal record),
	# the countryside feeds itself, recruits steadily, and breeds none of
	# the unrest that East-Elbian villages produced in the same decades.
	positive_modifier = {
		scale = { value = scope:maintenance }

		global_population_growth = 0.00218
		pop_join_rebel_threshold = 0.02
	}

	# (timber trespass), the Markdinge fall silent, and the Eigenbehoerige
	# tenure decays toward simple labour-rent: the rural peace breaks.
	negative_modifier = {
		scale = {
			value = 1
			subtract = scope:maintenance
		}
		global_monthly_prosperity = -0.001
		peasants_estate_satisfaction_decay = 0.020
	}
}

	}

		has_game_rule = nd_bureaucracies_enabled
	}

	# The salt monopoly required southern-Chinese coastal salterns:
	# Yangzhou (the commission's seat), Hangzhou (the Liang-zhe
	# salterns), or the Yangzi metropolis Jiangning (Nanjing).
	allow = {

			owns = location:yangzhou

			owns = location:jiangning
		}

		burghers_estate

	neutral_modifier = {
		burghers_estate_allowed_in_cabinet = yes
	}

	# functioning: yan-yin certificates circulate, the salterns
	# pour silver into the Tai-fu Si, salt-merchant houses underwrite
	# the imperial currency, the southern fisc carries the dynasty
	positive_modifier = {
		scale = { value = scope:maintenance }
		tax_income_efficiency = 0.085
		trade_income = 0.05
		monthly_inflation = -0.0025
	}

	# neglected: the monopoly turns extortionate, salt-smuggling
	# rebellions ferment in the south, peasant communities hit
	# by the salt levy join the Red Turbans
	negative_modifier = {
		scale = {
			value = 1
			subtract = scope:maintenance
		}
		peasants_estate_satisfaction_decay = 0.05
		pop_join_rebel_threshold = -0.10
	}
